test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The earthy / fragrance of soil / after a first rain / is always refreshing.
solution:
The correct answer is **After a first rain.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Point__**

__
 
• The correct sentence will be, **“****The earthy fragrance of soil after the first rain is always refreshing.”**
 
• **“A” **should be replaced by “the”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The “**first**” is a **specific number or a position;** therefore, we should **use the definite article** “**the” to refer to the specificity of the thing.**

 
 
• **​Example- ***The first sentence of a story should always be catchy*.
